admissible_byte_conventions: sha256_lf and sha256_crlf are the authorities; sha256 records the bytes of the tree that wrote the manifest and is informational. A checkout with core.autocrlf rewrites line endings without touching content, so requiring the raw digest would make the bundle unverifiable everywhere but on the machine that wrote it

pin_authority.how: a live lane file moves by design, so its authority is this dated capture and the attested field projection it records, not a digest published once
